scope_items.description: Overall phase breakdown, ordering, dependencies, deliverables per phase, and entry/exit criteria for each phase
Phase porting noisy_same_class_mixup utility plus its unit tests
Phase adding DINOv3Classifier model + DINOv3Linear algorithm (frozen-backbone linear-probe path) plus unit and integration tests
Phase enabling full-backbone fine-tune toggle (unfreeze + dual param groups) plus its tests
Phase adding LoRA/PiSSA support via peft wrapping plus checkpoint roundtrip tests
Phase adding DINOv3CustomWeights with three-format auto-detect (MD-Cls .ckpt, SINCHI raw .pt, SINCHI PEFT .pt) plus inference roundtrip tests
Phase covering config.yaml additions, README updates, docs/usage.md additions, requirements.txt extras, all additive
Fix CustomWeights num_layers=50 hardcode (latent bug from research report) plus regression test for ResNet-18 + ResNet-50 loading
Strategy for ensuring existing ResNet pipeline and existing CLI commands remain bit-identical (snapshot tests, hash checks, default-config invariants)
Overall test pyramid (unit / integration / regression / e2e) with which tests run per phase, what fixtures are needed, and what runs in CI vs local
End-to-end acceptance criteria mapped to research report's 10-item validation checklist, with concrete commands to execute and expected outputs
Risk register per phase (HF auth, GPU memory, transformers/peft optional deps, breaking edits) and rollback procedure (per-phase git revert points)

anti_narrowing_clause: This ledger is the convergence anchor. New in-scope items may be APPENDED with added_round marker, but no entry may be removed or ignored.
